full_inspection: Inspected all four native images completely and compared all original lines, formulas, word impressions and margins. Paired enlargements establish each overwritten Greek letter; the separate point above e remains uncertain. All handwriting and differing loci are recorded individually.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both complete original transcriptions. Copy2 changes plain l to script ell, records two overwritten Greek letters plus margin// and flags Yves. The actual ell is shared by both images; the overwritings, margin strokes and extra point occur only in copy2. Both archive readings are recorded.

entries.decision: retain the typed script ell in both checked copies
entries.reason: Both scans show the same looped special ell; original copy1 plain l was a glyph-reading error.

entries.decision: retain the copy2 mathematical revision in apparatus, preserving copy1 in the base
entries.reason: The underlying typed rho is visible in copy1; copy2 adds a dark loop and rightward sigma terminal over that same position.

entries.decision: retain the copy2 mathematical revision in apparatus, preserving copy1 in the base
entries.reason: The underlying typed sigma is visible in copy1; copy2 adds a heavy rho loop and long descending stem over that position.

entries.decision: retain the two oblique marginal strokes
entries.reason: Two pale parallel hand strokes occur only in copy2 beside the revised formula.

entries.decision: correct the copy2 grave-accent alternative to a doubtful point above e
entries.reason: The enlarged copy2 mark is round and separate; no corresponding point is visible in copy1. Its typed, handwritten or speck origin remains unresolved.

entries.decision: retain both distinct archive foliations without author attribution
entries.reason: Both lower-left hand numerals are clearly legible.
